test_title: PYST 09: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Raj has ₹1,218 with him. He divided it amongst his sons Varun and Ashish and asked them to invest it at 10% rate of interest per annum, compounded annually. It was seen that Varun and Ashish got the same amount after 13 and 14 years, respectively. How much (in ₹) did Raj give to Ashish?
solution:
**Given:**

Total amount Raj had = ₹1218

Rate of interest (r) = 10% per annum compounded annually

Varun got the amount after 13 years, Ashish after 14 years

Amount received by both is same

**Formula used:**

A = P(1+(r)/(100))^t

Where, A = Amount, P = Principal, r = rate, t = time

**Calculation:**

Let Varun's share = V and Ashish's share = A

V + A = 1218

V(1 + 10/100)¹³ = A(1 + 10/100)¹⁴

⇒ V(11/10)¹³ = A(11/10)¹⁴

⇒ V = A × (11/10)

Put in total equation:

⇒ V + A = 1218

⇒ A × (11/10) + A = 1218

⇒ A × (11/10 + 1) = 1218

⇒ A × (21/10) = 1218

⇒ A = 1218 × (10/21)

⇒ A = 58 × 10 = 580

**∴ Raj gave ₹580 to Ashish.**
